name: USB 5V to 12V Step-Up Cable for WiFi Router (5.5 × 2.1 mm)
shortDescription: Power your 12V WiFi router from any power bank with this USB boost cable.
description: A USB step-up cable that converts 5V from a power bank or USB adapter into 12V for routers, modems and small devices. A simple, low-cost way to keep your internet running during power cuts.
highlights: Runs routers from any power bank

specifications.label: Compatibility
specifications.value: 12V routers, modems, LED lamps, small fans
